subject: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade: evidence & remediation steps
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@medaxis.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medaxis.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade

Hi Rishi,

We pushed the 1.12.4 controlplane agents last night (maintenance window 01:00–02:00 PDT). Around 02:37 our inference nodes started showing brief stalls: connections to the controllink dropped for ~3–10s and some in-flight streams returned 500s. We reopened the older 1.12.2 agents and the cluster stabilized.

Can you share what telemetry or logs you need from our side? Our security team will only send sanitized bundles. Also need an ETA for a remediation plan and any interim mitigations we should apply.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, MedAxis Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@medaxis.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade

Hi Samantha — thanks for the report and for reverting quickly. We're treating this as a high-priority escalation. Short answers first, then concrete asks: 

1) What we need from MedAxis now (minimum):
   - sanitized controllink connection dumps from 02:30–03:00 UTC (capture attached filenames)
   - Kubernetes event logs for the conductor and agent Pods in that window
   - Any sample request IDs where you saw 500s (trace IDs)

2) Our immediate mitigation: we will produce a hotfix candidate to address a heartbeat edge case introduced in 1.12.4 and recommend sticking to 1.12.2 until validated.

3) ETA: log analysis + initial root-cause hypothesis in 6 business hours; hotfix candidate within 24 hours.

I'll loop Marcus (runtime) and Irene (private deploys) for the technical dive. Monica from Customer Success will coordinate evidence sharing and timelines with you.

Quick next step: please upload the sanitized bundle to the S3 path below (or the Drive link if that's easier) and reply here confirming upload. We'll ack once we've pulled it.

S3: s3://redwood-evidence/medaxis/2028-06-15/logs/
Drive (share link): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cEXAMPLE

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha@medaxis.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade

Thanks — I pulled the initial dumps from the S3 location and started running the correlation script. Early observation: we see repeated ephemeral TLS renegotiations from agents that coincide with KV cache flush events on the conductor. Timing lines up with Samantha's reported stalls.

Requesting two additional items from MedAxis:
 - agent logs at DEBUG level for conductor/agent from 02:25–02:45 (rotated logs OK)
 - the exact helm release name+revision used for the 1.12.4 rollout so we can check chart diffs (cc: rk-1.12.4-upgrade-diff.txt)

I'm opening INF-4021 to track the analysis and will attach the initial timeline and packet captures.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@medaxis.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medaxis.com, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade

Uploading the sanitized bundle now to s3://redwood-evidence/medaxis/2028-06-15/logs/ (connection_dumps_20280615.tar.gz). We've redacted internal IPs and patient-identifiable strings per our policy. Helm release name: medaxis-priv-prod, revision: 87.

We also included three example trace IDs: medaxis-3c9ef, medaxis-3c9f0, medaxis-3c9f3 where services returned 500s. Let us know if you need anything else. We prefer a short follow-up call (30 minutes) to walk through mitigations rather than many back-and-forth emails.

—Samantha

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@medaxis.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — controllink flare after 1.12.4 upgrade: remediation plan and evidence deliverables

Samantha — thanks for the bundle and the helm info; appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary of next steps and attachments we just uploaded: 

1) Initial findings (attached summary and timeline): repeated TLS renegotiations between agents and conductor triggered by a heartbeat edge in 1.12.4 that causes short-lived session invalidations when small windowed reauth occurs during KV cache flushes. We have a test case that reproduces the behavior in our staging harness.

2) Hotfix plan: patch to skip reauth during immediate post-flush window and increase heartbeat grace to 2x for 10 minutes during rollout. We'll provide a binary for you to test in a canary subset (1 node) within 12 hours.

3) Runbook & evidence: uploaded redwood_runbook_controllink_20280615.pdf and the analysis bundle to the Drive link. Also attached rk-1.12.4-upgrade-diff.txt with the chart changes we verified.

4) Risk/rollback: plan includes an automated rollback to 1.12.2 if >1% of requests hit 500s during the canary; Monica will coordinate action with your Ops.

Can we schedule a 30-minute bridge at 16:00 PDT today to review the hotfix test and the rollback gating criteria? Monica will share a calendar invite if that works.

I'll mark INF-4021 as P1 and keep you updated in that ticket with artifacts.

Thanks,
Rishi
